At opening, a toast to the welfare lead
The new month is here
Pet Cabin Notes for a smooth boarding day

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is leaning into calm routines and clear handoffs, which keeps pets and people on steadier ground. Small checks, kind voices, and tidy carrier labels go a long way, and the ground team is still moving each animal with care from curb to cabin. <<FACT F033>> For travelers, that means fewer surprises and more trust in the process, whether you are sending a nervous cat, a chatty pup, or a well-settled companion like Cookie.

We are also keeping a close eye on comfort in the air and on the tone of every update from the desk. <<FACT F041>> If plans change, please share the news quickly and respectfully so the next handoff stays smooth. The best trips start with patience, good notes, and a little extra reassurance for everyone involved.
